verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Channel3 adopting other parties' protocols (MCP, UCP, MPP) and listing MCP clients that can connect to its server. It does not show any independent party implementing Channel3's own protocol or platform. A single community developer building on top of the API is a consumer, not an independent implementation. Interoperating with third-party protocols is adjacent to the story, not evidence that Channel3's platform is an ecosystem.

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration
